startedBy.speaker: Elmus
startedBy.speakerNamed: alias Elmus of DLC2ThirskFFElmus (Elmus Favor Quest) (unique)
startedBy.prompt: Is there anything that would make being down here more bearable?
reply: Well, the easy answer, of course. Mead!
Actually, now that I think of it, I have been missing the Ashfire. It's a special brew that we make at Thirsk.
If you could... somehow... get up there and grab a bottle, I'd be a long way towards forgetting how miserable it is down here.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias Elmus; Elmus Favor Quest stage < 10

firstObjective.text: Bring Elmus some Ashfire Mead from Thirsk Mead Hall

startedBy.source: DLC2_QF_DLC2MH01_0201A50B.fragment_2 on Dragonborn.esm:01A50B (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Elmus
startedBy.speakerNamed: alias Elmus of DLC2ThirskFFElmusBack (Elmus Favor Quest) (unique)
reply: We lost most of the batches we had brewing when... before those things were here.
One is just ready to take its turn, though, and it's about time to add some of the flavorings.
You can't find them on Solstheim, but if you find yourself back in Skyrim, I wouldn't mind you bringing some juniper berries.
They add a different kind of sweetness. Tart. Makes the flavor more round.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias Elmus; Elmus Favor Quest stage < 10

startedBy.source: DLC2_QF_DLC2MH01_0201A50B.fragment_2 on Dragonborn.esm:01A50B (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Halbarn Iron-Fur
startedBy.speakerNamed: alias Halbarn of DLC2ThirskFFHalbarn (Halbarn Favor Quest) (unique)
startedBy.prompt: Are you getting back to work?
reply: Cleaning out the forge was the easy part. But those blasted rieklings made off with most of my materials.
You tend to wander around, don't you? If you come across any stalhrim or ebony in your travels, bring them back to old Halbarn. Help each other out.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias Halbarn; Halbarn Favor Quest stage < 10

firstObjective.text: Bring <Global=DLC2ThirskHalbarnStalhrimCount> Stalhrim and <Global=DLC2ThirskHalbarnEbonyCount> Ebony Ingots to Halbarn

startedBy.source: DLC2_QF_DLC2MH01_0201A50B.fragment_2 on Dragonborn.esm:01A50B (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Hilund
startedBy.speakerNamed: alias Hilund of DLC2ThirskFFHilund (Hilund Favor Quest) (unique)
reply: To tell you the truth, I've been a little distracted. I've got this... idea.
I want to make a reminder. So we never forget what happened the last time we got soft.
I want to ring the whole hall with their little spears. Mocking us, from the past. Making us work harder. Fight better.
The only problem is, I'm going to need a lot of spears. A lot. So, if you could find a bunch of them for me, that would make it easier.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias Hilund; Hilund Favor Quest stage < 10

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
